problems_fixed.what: Replaced degenerate difference-of-two-squares problem: the old (x+5)(x-5) let a student pattern-match a²-b² straight from the method card / worked example (x+7)(x-7) and pick x²-25 without algebra. New problem needs a=2x recognised. Options and misconceptions rebuilt.

Ambiguous wording fix (answer unchanged): display did not say 'and simplify', so option x+5x (an un-simplified expansion) was arguably defensible. Added 'and simplify' to match the required simplification level and the worked examples.

opener_concept: Party bags: 3 bags each holding 1 cupcake + 4 sweets. Student counts 3×1 cupcakes and 3×4 sweets by common sense; the reveal names this as sharing the multiplier over every term, i.e. 3(x+4)=3x+12 = expanding a bracket.
notes: All 20 bank problems fresh-solved with sympy: every stored correct option matches the true expansion; all problems non-calculator with clean integer-coefficient answers. Whole lesson was multiple_choice with NO hints, NO tier_guides, NO guided (opener/teach), and misconceptions copied verbatim across tiers where they could never fire (audit issues 1-4). Rebuilt: added a plain-text hint to every problem; rebuilt every problem's misconceptions so each expect is an option index that the described error actually produces and never equals the correct index (verified). Removed the double-bracket 'missed_term/middle_term/forgot_squared/sign_error' messages from single-bracket bronze problems where they were meaningless (audit issues 1-4); single-bracket messages now speak of 'multiply every term inside', 'added not multiplied', and only use forgot_squared on B5/B6 (x-multipliers). Added tier_guides (bronze/silver/gold), guided.opener (party-bag hook), and guided.teach walks (bronze 5(2x+3); silver (x+5)(x-2); gold (3x+2)²) each with >=4 numeric boxes and a substitution check. Slimmed method_card to <=140 words / 4 steps. guided_steps intentionally omitted on all problems (input_type multiple_choice; validator permits).
